channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: ‘In my DNA’: Why Osaka’s high-risk danjiri festivals refuse to slow down
item.description: A pair of fatal incidents this month has revived a long-running debate: Does Osaka's high-risk danjiri festival still have a place in modern society?

item.title: Japan’s biggest labor union federation calls for 6% wage hike in 2027
item.description: Member unions typically submit their wage demands by around February, with companies responding from March onward.

item.title: SoftBank market value halves from peak as AI fears grow
item.description: After briefly overtaking Toyota as Japan's biggest company, SoftBank's market capitalization is now smaller than that of Hitachi and Recruit.

item.title: Japan to introduce cashless traffic fine payments from July
item.description: Fines are currently payable only at bank or post office counters, which are unavailable outside business hours.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
